text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne down on lower CBOT soy complex calls and rain on Canada's Prairies. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +2.78 Friday from -0.02 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3900 to the U.S. dollar, rose to 82.92 yen, fell to 1.2389 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 lower on spillover pressure from allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 down on lower CBOT corn calls. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to continue selling spreads.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls and rain forecast for Canada's Prairies.
Feed grains were expected to fall C$5 to C$10 to entice consumptive demand in the near term, some sources said.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
